deviations.deviation: RTX 2000 Ada 16 GB instead of the planned A4500: input-embedding table kept on the CPU (exact lookup); blocks and lm_head bf16 on the GPU; batch 10/8/6
generation caps 384 (bench) / 512 (T2) / 640 (T1) instead of 1024/1536; 0 Stage A truncations, ST alpha-8 rows hit the cap
A3/B3 Stage A not run (drop-order item 4; GPU time)
analysis code frozen in amendment commits 3 (before scoring) and 4 (post-hoc sensitivity, identifiability check), not in commit 0
L event table frozen in commit 1 (before any opening pass); forecast values in commit 1b before scoring
no base composition on disk for the 7 existing-task Qwen events: BASE = runner-up-weighted forecast there
OPEN uses up to 6 programs per algorithm (bench), 1 (panel units) or 2 (path tasks); FP8 events scored with the bf16 engine
raw S2 has no common support with S0 on log D_R on both tasks; S2E used as the S2 arm (plan fallback); S1E overshoots S0 and is not used
alpha <= 4 indicator model added post hoc (amendment 4), labelled as such
top-five landing test restricted to landings on survivor algorithms
novelty judge instructions refined after a 1-program smoke test (library calls implementing a catalogue algorithm count as that algorithm)
U3: spec-span exchange vs KV splice differs by 0.5 logits at R (bf16, different GEMM shapes); top-1 and 10/10 labels equal; reported, not failed over
exp20 hull prices (H5 per site) not computed (time); paired flips and MH ORs reported instead

code changed after commit 0: gpu6.py gained the ext stage (written before it ran) and the extension prompts; analysis/report/output code was fixed and frozen in amendments 3 and 4; cfg6.py path defaults were made workspace-relative (no logic change); the GPU stage code of every committed decisive cell ran as hashed in commit 0

after the run, every prior-artifact file the code reads was mirrored into inputs_extra/ and cfg6.EXP reads those mirrors first (the original locations remain in cfg6.EXP_ORIG for the STEP-0 gate); scripts/finalize.sh uses src/format_outputs6.py unless AII_JSON_SKILL is set; the rebuilt L event table is identical to the frozen one

planned_deviations.D-GPU: RTX 2000 Ada 16 GB (plan: A4500): input-embedding table on the CPU (exact lookup), lm_head and all blocks on the GPU in bf16
planned_deviations.D-CAP: max_new 384 (bench) / 512 (T2) / 640 (T1) instead of 1024/1536: exp27 p99 lengths are <= 250 / 227 / 437 tokens; truncation rate reported
planned_deviations.D-A3B3: A3/B3 (drop-order item 4) not run: time budget of this GPU
planned_deviations.D-AC: analysis code hashed in an amendment commit before scoring, not in commit #0
planned_deviations.D-L: L event table frozen in commit #1 (before any teacher-forced opening pass)
